items.question: Was a meeting held with the client at the start of the audit, and the date and attendees recorded?
Has the team recorded its understanding of the client business: what it sells, to whom, how it earns money, and where it operates?
Has the team recorded who owns and manages the client, who is charged with governance, and how decisions are made?
For an existing client, has the team recorded what changed in operations, people, products, locations, systems, financing or the law since last year?
Has the client confirmed which accounting records, bank statements, agreements and other documents will be provided, and by what date?
Has the client confirmed the key contacts for each area, including who can explain the accounting system?
Have the significant accounting policies of the client and any changes in them been discussed and recorded?
Has the client been asked about known or suspected fraud, non-compliance with laws, litigation and disputes with tax or other authorities?
Has the client been told the agreed fieldwork dates and what late or incomplete records will do to the time budget?
